column1: # Launch-zone auto mute (Ken, Nov 23): strong sources near the takeoff point, on the ground
# and through the initial climb, are muted. Shared by test_btrx_bearing.c (engine) and the
# Kotlin/Swift settings-text tests. Nov 23 Timberland replay (in.bbv1, not in the repo):
# XY_Rdy -58 dBm 2 m / 6 m AGL / 41 s and ZA-hl- -60 dBm 2 m / 12 m AGL / 44 s muted; the
# hearing aids 0AAyNX / TteXDe first heard -88 / -92 dBm 295-304 m from takeoff at 48 m AGL
# The climb ends the first time the drone leaves the zone; after that only reports on the
# ground (<= 5 m AGL) near the takeoff point count. via = out: the drone first flies to 100 m
# east at 30 m AGL, 20 s before the report (Nov 20: the watch 16 m N of takeoff, heard on the
# way back at 10 m AGL, stays unmuted).
